data.headline: Head of Risk & Control, ING
data.about:
Experienced leader who has worked globally in banking and finance, across risk management, regulatory compliance, regulator engagement, technology, cyber, operatonal resilience, program management, change management and process improvement. Andy is commercially minded, innovative, pragmatic and offers many years of professional risk judgement experience to provide a balanced view of risk and reward.

For most of his career, Andy has been focused on building and embedding strong, sustainable risk capabilities and cultures, while building and leading teams of risk and compliance professionals. 

Andy is collaborative and fosters solid relationships with stakeholders, at all levels. He is passionate about coaching, mentoring, and providing growth and development opportunities for his team.

In his spare time Andy is involved in aviation as a private pilot and is passionate about safety and risk management in aviation.

description.text:
At the digital bank, ING, Andy leads the Technology Risk and Control function, as a direct report to the Chief Information Officer. Andy is the leader of a team of Line-1 Risk and Compliance professionals, located in Australia, India and the Philippines. Andy is accountable for Risk Advisory across Technology (including  Operational Resilience and Cybersecurity), Controls Assurance, SOX, Regulatory Compliance, Incident Response, Governance and Risk in Change functions. 
His team implements and oversees the bank’s IT General Controls (ITGC) and related SOX testing. Andy directly oversees the effective adoption of the bank’s Risk Management and Compliance Frameworks and monitors and reports on risk performance, including controls effectiveness, incident and control remediation and improvement initiatives. He provides practical regulatory advice and interpretation of compliance obligations in the areas of Cybersecurity (CPS234, SOCI), Operational Resilience (CPS230, DORA), Outsourcing and more generally across risk management (CPS220). 
Andy chairs the Technology Division’s Risk and Governance Forum and the bank’s Cloud Risk Committee, as well as regularly attending the Executive Committee, Board Risk Committee and Board Technology Transformation Committee. He ensures senior executive awareness and governance to support strategic decision making and business prioritisation.

At CBA Andy was a trusted advisor to the CTO and more broadly to the Technology leadership and Risk and Compliance teams. He provided proactive, consultative advice, and review and challenge of the division’s approach to managing risk, remediation priorities and the related controls and compliance arrangements, aligned to the bank’s Operational Risk and Compliance Management Frameworks. Andy was also instrumental in supporting CBA’s prudential compliance, working as an advisor and approver of APRA’s Prudential Standards, and as the largest employer at the bank, overseeing conduct and personal compliance for the Technology division. As a member of the bank’s crisis management team, Andy led regulatory engagements during major disruptions and operational resilience events (including cyber-attacks, data breaches, system outages, third-party incidents and natural disasters affecting customers and staff).

subComponents.title: Head of Compliance, Technology, Payments, Cybersecurity, & Resilience

description.text: Andy joined CBA in August 2017, to establish the Technology and Operations Compliance function, reporting to the divisional Chief Risk Officer. This was a Line 2 role, leading all aspects of regulatory compliance for technology, cyber, operational resilience, cloud, outsourcing, payments, and data. Andy also led the Line 2 function for the newly created CBA India business and led operational risk for the Chief Operations Office. Andy went on to lead Risk and Compliance for the Chief Technology Office (CTO), focusing equally on operational risk and regulatory compliance.

description.text: At Westpac, Andy led strategic programs of work and transformations, most notably leading product design and development for the newly established Bank of Melbourne and leading business process outsourcing initiatives. At the completion of this work Andy commenced his risk and compliance career by winning the role of Head of Compliance, Group Services, Technology and Operations.
